title: CS5351 Requirements Registry Schema
description: JSON Schema used by CI to validate the machine-readable requirements registry (docs/req/requirements.yaml coerced to JSON).

project.description: Short identifier of the target project.

description.description: One-paragraph narrative describing the enhancement scope.

registry_notes.description: Optional registry-level metadata (e.g. which requirement anchors traceability or the safety boundary).

requirement.description: A single requirement entry. Every requirement has an ID, a type, a statement, a machine-checkable fit criterion, and a priority.

id.description: Unique, machine-parseable requirement ID, e.g. REQ-CONTEXT-BUDGET.

fit_criterion.description: A machine-checkable fit criterion, typically expressed as METRIC + THRESHOLD + VERIFY or as an invariant with zero tolerance.

tradeoff.description: Explicit statement of the tradeoff accepted when assigning the priority.

source.description: Where the requirement came from (e.g. analysis of the existing system, instructor notes).

fit_criterion_machine_checkable.description: Whether the fit criterion is machine-checkable.
